context: current GitHub-hosted Ubique repository and retained episode window

P.basis: continuity is evidenced by persisted generations, not treated as intelligence

Z.basis: distinct successful functional command states in retained episodes

L.basis: distinct observed successful source-provider-command solution paths

limitations: Z/K/R/L are observable diversity proxies, not normalized intelligence scores.
G_A is observational unless the specific mechanism has a valid intervention.

ablation.A: retain remote reasoning availability after loss of one healthy provider
ablation.C: persisted provider ledger under a structural one-provider-loss perturbation
ablation.identification: structural robustness proxy only; no live provider was disabled and this is not a general causal estimate of task performance
ablation.M_S_minus: single-provider structural control under the same one-provider-loss perturbation
